title: Missed Connection?
content: I visit the dream world on a nightly basis, except last night was different. Last night I had been texting with a guy, Zachary, and we really hit it off and then I ended up meeting his friends before meeting him directly. But once we did finally meet, sparks flew, I knew he wanted to kiss me and then I woke up…. Not sure if Zachary is real but maybe you saw me too ?
